reviews.title: Keeps our pool crystal clear and lasts a long time! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.body: This chlorine works fantastic. We have a 4-foot pool, and this product keeps the water crystal clear with very little effort. The tablets dissolve at a perfect, steady pace, meaning they last a long time and maintain consistent chemical levels without needing constant attention. It handles the summer heat perfectly and keeps algae away. Highly recommend!The lid is hard for me to get off, but I do have problems with my hands. However the bucket it comes in is very sturdy and nice.

reviews.title: Crystal Clear Pool Maintenance Made Simple
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Xtremeclear 3” Swimming Pool Chlorine Tablets (5 lb bucket, 10 count) for about 2 weeks now in my 20,000 gallon pool with spa, using about 4 tablets a week in a floater.The price felt fair for the quality, and so far they’ve kept my pool crystal clear with steady, reliable chlorine levels. The tablets dissolve evenly and work well in the floater without causing any cloudiness or issues.Shipping was quick, which was a plus since I needed to get my pool treated right away. Overall, this is a solid, budget-friendly option that gets the job done and keeps maintenance simple.
